changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: UPDATE process_definition_building_block_definition SET main = true WHERE (process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag) IN ( SELECT process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag FROM ( SELECT link.process_definition_id, link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, pd.key_ ORDER BY pd.version_ DESC ) AS link_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN link.main THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, pd.key_ ) AS has_main FROM process_definition_building_block_definition link JOIN act_re_procdef pd ON pd.id_ = link.process_definition_id ) ranked WHERE ranked.link_rank = 1 AND ranked.has_main = 1 )

changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM process_definition_building_block_definition WHERE (process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag) IN ( SELECT process_definition_id, building_block_definition_key, building_block_definition_version_tag FROM ( SELECT link.process_definition_id, link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY link.building_block_definition_key, link.building_block_definition_version_tag, pd.key_ ORDER BY pd.version_ DESC ) AS link_rank FROM process_definition_building_block_definition link JOIN act_re_procdef pd ON pd.id_ = link.process_definition_id ) ranked WHERE ranked.link_rank > 1 )
